verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents generating API credentials under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, with configurable permissions and an optional expiry date. That directly supports issuing scoped, time-bounded credentials that could be given to an agent. Endpoint docs name specific permissions (e.g. "Monitor and unmonitor customers", "View roles in account"), which indicates permissions are granular per endpoint. missing for 10: a documented full permission catalogue showing how finely credentials can be scoped, agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
